 We’re looking for a Test Automation Engineer with solid iOS automation experience (Swift + XCUITest) to join our team working on a social news aggregation platform . In this role, you’ll take ownership of automating test suites, maintaining stability across releases, and ensuring a smooth, high-quality user experience. You’ll collaborate closely with product and development teams, contribute to release testing, and continuously improve our internal automation framework.
 What You’ll Do
Create and maintain automated test cases, execute test suites, reviews and diagnoses reported bugs, and ensures overall system quality prior to a production release.
Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot automated suites of tests through continuous integration for value added feedback.
Maintain test infrastructure stability in non-production environments.
Participate in troubleshooting and triaging of issues with different teams to drive towards root cause identification and resolution.
Work closely with software developers to create software artifacts including test plans, test cases, test procedures and test reports.
Work across functional areas with internal partner engineering teams in a disciplined agile environment.
Estimate own testing tasks and work productively with minimum supervision while showing excellent team attitude.
Influence the entire engineering organization on unit/integration/end-to-end tests.
 What You Bring
4+ years of experience in building automation frameworks for mobile/web applications particularly social media or related app. 
High proficiency in testing methodology, SDLC methodology, test documentation procedures, and QA Best Practices. 
Independently chalk out test plans based on requirements. 
Strong communication skills. 
Ability to identify area of impact in the app based on the requirements to do adhoc and exploratory testing. 
Comfortable with iOS and Android testing environments. 
Ability to work in a fast paced development environment. 
Creative problem-solving skills. 
Experience testing Agile/Scrum SDLC, and skill using tools such as JIRA and Confluence to manage the lifecycle. 
 Nice to have
At least 3 years of Experience in testing applications across platforms iOS, Android, Web and Mobile Web. 
Experience with API testing. 
Experience working in a fast paced work environment where prod releases happen every week. 
 Tech stack
Mobile testing general concepts
Programming language: Swift
Test framework: XCUITest
IDE: XCode
Cloud testing: BrowserStack
Agile methodologies (SCRUM)
Test Case Management tools
CI/CD: Bitrise
GIT
Jira
Desirable: scripting skills.
